items.title: Former Target CEO Brian Cornell on How Exiting Canada Paved the Way for U.S. Growth
items.summary: Former Target CEO Brian Cornell tells WSJ Leadership Institute President Alan Murray why he decided in 2014 to pull the retailer out of Canada. Cornell reflects on the difficult decision to close 133 stores and says Target likely wouldn’t have added $40 billion in U.S. growth had it remained in Canada. The two spoke at the WSJ Leadership Institute Board of Directors Summit in Palm Beach, Florida.
